title: Frank Zappa explains the decline of the music business
summary: A short Frank Zappa interview clip on the decline of the music business, contrasting old cigar-chomping executives with younger industry people.
why: HN quotes it as a prescient take on industry decline and on how young, hip managers can be more conservative than the old guard.

quote.text: The young guys are more conservative, and more dangerous to the artform, than the old guys with the cigars ever were!
